title: API Rate Limiting
description: Runnable companion for the API rate limiting recipe: atomic Lua token bucket for Redis, Express sliding-window middleware, and pytest coverage for enforcement, failover, and distributed consistency.
description_es: Companion ejecutable de la receta de rate limiting de APIs: token bucket atómico con Lua para Redis, middleware sliding-window para Express y cobertura pytest para enforcement, failover y consistencia distribuida.
